annotations.title: What a North Carolina (NC) statute cites, and what cites it

description:
Which North Carolina (NC) statutes this section cites, and which cite it.

Use for "what does G.S. 14-72.1 depend on" or "what else references it". OUTBOUND is
what the section's own text cites; INBOUND is every section citing it — the direction
you cannot get by reading one statute.

Section-level only: a reference to 20-141(j1) is an edge to 20-141. Chapter-wide and
"this Article" references are not edges. For the text itself use get_statute.

citation.description: The section whose references you want, in either direction.
